text: Based on Earth-observation evidence, **this asset is deforestation-free**. The analysis shows **no forest cover** was present in **2020** (JRC GFC2020), and the **Hansen dataset** detected **no deforestation events** since **2000**. The asset had **tree cover in 2000** (34.5 ha, ≥30% canopy) but **zero forest in 2020**, confirming no recent deforestation. The data meets the **50% corroboration rule** and the **0.5-ha minimum event threshold**, ensuring reliability. No deforestation was observed between **2020–2025**, the latest available year.
